headline: Defender's WATCH now answers to 40 seeds and a crash law
lede: Batch 21 of the WATCH rollout didn't rewrite Defender's patrol — it proved what the patrol is actually made of. The witness replays doubled to 40 seeds including an untuned holdout, and a new law pins that no seed ever loses two of its three lives in a 150-second patrol. Six redesigns were measured to try to kill the last graze; every one was rejected with numbers, and the README now carries the receipts.

notes.text: WITNESS grew a second set: 20 tuned witness seeds plus 20 holdout seeds nobody ever tuned against — all 40 survive, floors pinned at 7800/1350, rescue pins raised 30→40 against a measured 46/47.

The new crash law — no seed crashes twice per patrol — is guarded by a sentinel mutant that dies when the patrol's terrain lift-off is deleted. defendercheck 88/88 with all 17 mutants killed; watchcheck 216/216.

Six policing designs (run-out guards, momentum brakes, fresh facing, standoff, duel priority) measured on the same seeds: guards starve the guns (104 waves to 17), brakes buy flow but reshape one seed into the reject band, the standoff stalemates wave clears. The patrol's one early graze is the honest price of its kill flow — the law ships pinned, the route stays.
